motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Lenis duration and cubic ease; bypassed for reduced motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: GSAP clipped entry reveal; reduced-motion bypass.

motion.name: roll-smoothing
motion.purpose: Input-driven opposing tracks; .07 per nominal 60Hz frame, corrected for elapsed time.

motion.name: panel-stack
motion.purpose: Prior panel pins until next top reaches viewport top; long panels (>1.02 viewport heights) begin at bottom bottom, short panels at top top. Scale scrubs while next moves top bottom to top top. Preserve DOM order without artificial panel/pin-spacer z-indexes; pale cover must difference-blend through the pinned cloud.

motion.name: roll-input
motion.purpose: Terminal footer consumes section-wide input; tracks repeat three copies in opposing directions.

motion.name: roll-reverse-release
motion.purpose: Accumulated reverse input first reverses gallery, then subsequent reverse input releases document scroll. User-observation threshold, not an extracted reference constant; Home/Escape also exit.

motion.name: source-interludes
motion.value: full-viewport film interlude before photo cloud; pale interlude before Work
motion.purpose: Source-order restoration: empty film-interlude.scroll-panel matches .panel.reel with rgba(27,14,14,.306), mix-blend-mode:difference. Film interlude is hidden under reduced motion. These transitions preserve the reference stack sequence rather than adding a new visual direction. Pale #f0f0f0 cover difference-blends to retain inverted cloud imagery and text.

motion.name: progressive-route-loader
motion.value: 500ms delay; decoded tile/120ms; minimum 2s; .45s sweep; .25s fade at .3s; 7s failsafe
motion.purpose: Initially black image-free markup; remounted per public route; reduced-motion bypass; dashboard immediate.

referenceTypography.responsive: 1100px, 991px and 650px overrides follow the source; do not normalize these additions as drift.

referencePages.services: Single-word hero and lower biography; pinned film roll with narrative; category WorkBoard; pale transition; plain footer. Roll reverts on route cleanup and becomes static for reduced motion.
referencePages.stories: Three viewport media-left/copy-right panels and editorial footer.
referencePages.contact: About and Process editorial panels followed by media/contact footer.
referencePages.works: Square auto-fill 280px grid, 320px at 1600px; two mobile columns; overlaid category/title; own working filters; visually hidden title; direct project links; no gallery footer.
referencePages.viewer: Body portal, native controls and mute keyboard access, bounded focus, Escape, inert background, scroll lock and trigger focus restoration.
referencePages.limits: Seven illustrative projects and temporary reference assets; no live frame parity certification. Page audit and home gallery regression passed with zero errors; final production build passed.

narrative.overview:
The visual authority is the user's chosen reference, thomasmamfredas.com. Preserve its monochrome film-led composition, compact navigation, large typography, asymmetric media arrangements, and smooth spatial motion while substituting John's identity. This is a code-led replication: no separate build specification or approved composition exists.

This document records the source-aligned implementation and its provisional fidelity limits, not final brand approval. The public portfolio is spacious and cinematic; the studio dashboard is a quieter light workspace. Temporary reference photography and films are not John's portfolio and require replacement with his licensed work before public launch. Source inspection and remaining replication differences are recorded in `docs/REFERENCE-AUDIT.md`; downloaded reference material lives under `audit/source/`.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome surfaces with grayscale film and photography.
Full-screen film heroes and asymmetric editorial media.
Inter display typography with compact Arimo supporting text.
Flat controls, fine separators, and visible keyboard states.
Smooth motion with reduced-motion and static media fallbacks.

rules.name: The Monochrome Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep public interface chrome neutral; color may emerge from the media rather than an added decorative accent.

dos: **Do** preserve the pinned reference's monochrome cinematic editorial system.
**Do** use the final cascading CSS values when duplicate declarations exist.
**Do** keep keyboard focus and reduced-motion fallbacks visible and usable.
**Do** identify temporary reference assets and illustrative projects honestly.
**Do** retain the light dashboard's operational hierarchy and text status labels.
donts: **Don't** add a new aesthetic direction, decorative accent palette, or rounded card system.
**Don't** claim exact reference fidelity or final visual approval from this provisional implementation.
**Don't** present the reference creator's work, clients, or identity as John's.
**Don't** make motion or pointer-only exploration the sole route to project content.
